_what_is: One entry per type of business you want to find. 'osm' = OpenStreetMap tag filters [key, regex] (a business matches if ANY filter matches); 'searches' = web search terms (Brave) combined with each city; 'keywords' = words that confirm on the company's own site that it is this type of business (signal S); 'subject' and 'block' = the email subject and the paragraph describing what you offer this sector, one per locale; 'offer' = which entry of variants.json the sector uses; 'priority' 1 = best, 3 = worst; 'active': false switches a sector off. 'always_exclude' lists what is never contacted, whatever the sector.
